article.headline: Cal State Northridge knocks off Hawaii 82-73
article.description: — Marcus Adams Jr.'s 21 points helped Cal State Northridge defeat Hawaii 82-73 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Cal State Northridge knocks off Hawaii 82-73

categories.description: Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors @ Cal State Northridge Matadors

event.description: Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors @ Cal State Northridge Matadors

keywords: Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors @ Cal State Northridge Matadors
article.story: LOS ANGELES -- — Marcus Adams Jr.'s 21 points helped Cal State Northridge defeat Hawaii 82-73 on Saturday. Adams also contributed eight rebounds for the Matadors (22-9, 14-6 Big West Conference). Tyler Beard scored 19 points while going 6 of 11 from the floor, including 4 for 4 from 3-point range, and 3 for 4 from the line and added six rebounds and six assists. PJ Fuller shot 6 for 11, including 3 for 4 from beyond the arc to finish with 16 points. Gytis Nemeiksa led the way for the Rainbow Warriors (15-16, 7-13) with 20 points. Akira Jacobs added 14 points for Hawaii. Tom Beattie also recorded 13 points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
